paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul sih nung in Amalekte zou khin David ahong kik nawn a, Ziklag ah David ni nih a-om hi.
heading: David In Saul Sih Thu Athei

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni in, ngai in, mi khat Saul panmun a kipan apuante bohkeksa leh alu a lei kai niaunuau in ahong pai hi.
David kiang ahong tun in lei a bokkhup in zahtakna apia hi. David in akiang ah, "Koi a pan hong pai na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Israel mite panmun a pan hong taikhia ka hi," achi hi.

David in akiang ah, "Bangchibang in thil a-om a? Hon hilh dih ve," achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kidouna a pan mite ataikek ua, mi tampi puk in asi uh. Saul leh atapa Jonathan leng asi tuaktuak uh," achi hi.
David in amah hilhpa tangval kiang ah, "Bangchi in ahia Saul leh atapa Jonathan asih uh na theih?" achi hi.
Ahilhpa tangval in, "Bangchi chi hiam in Gilboa tang ah ka na om kha zenzen hi. Ngai in, ateipi ngai a Saul dingh ka mu a, kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite'n hon naihta uhi.
Anunglam angatleh ahon mu a, hon sam hi. Ke'n, 'Hiai ah ka om,' chi in ka dawng hi.
Ka kiang ah, 'Kua na hia?' ahon chi hi. Ke'n, Amalek mi ka hi, chi in ka dawng hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, 'Ka kiang ah hong dingh inla hong that mai dih, ka hing lai vanglak a, lungdonna in lah hon manta ngal a,' achi hi.
Akiang ah ka dingh a, huchi a pukgawp khinsa, damzou nawn lou ding chih ka theih ziak in ka thatta mai hi. Alu a lallukhu leh aban a tau ka la a, ka pu kiang ah ka hon tawi hi,” achi hi.
David in apuansilhte abotkekta a, huchi mah bang in akiang a mi om tengteng in leng ahih uhi.
Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh TOUPA mite leh Israel inkuante asuun ua, akah ua, nitaklam tan in an angawl ua, namsau a thah ahih ziakun.
David in amah va hilhtu tangval kiang ah, "Koilam mi na hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Gamdangmi, Amalek mi tapa ka hi," chi in adawng hi. David in akiang ah, "TOUPA thaunilh hihmang dia atung a khut khak bangchidan a lau lou na hia le?" achi hi.
David in tangval khat asam a, "Va naih inla, that in," achi a, ama'n ava sat a, asita hi.
David in akiang ah, "Na sisan nangmah lutung ah om hen. Nangmah kam ngei in, TOUPA thaunilh ka that ahi, chi a na puan tak man in," achi hi.
David in Saul leh atapa Jonathan hiai kahtam in asuun hi:
heading: David In Saul Leh Jonathan Akah

paite: Thalkapdan Judah suante sinsak ding in asawl a, ngai in, Jasher laibu ah hiai gelh ahi:
Aw Israel, na kilawmna mun sangte ah athat ua, na mihatte apukta uh.
Gath ah gen kei unla, Ashkelon kongzingte ah puang kei un. Huchi lou in zaw Philistia tanute akipak ding ua, Ezeksum louh tanute avualzou kha ding uhi.
Nou Gilboa tangte aw, na tung uah daitui leh vuah ke kei hen. Thillat dingte leng suah sam ke'n. Huai ah lah mihat lum Saul lum, thaunilh louh mi lum bang mai in giloutak in apaimang uhi.
Thah a omte sisan a pan leh mihat thau a pan Jonathan thal akik nawn kei a, Saul namsau avuak in akik nawn kei hi.
Saul leh Jonathan hindan adeihhuai in akilawm a, asih un leng akikhen kei uh. Mupite sang in ahatzaw ua, humpinelkaite sang in ahatzaw uhi.
Nou Israel tanute aw, Saul kah un, puansan kilawmte na tung uah abaang a, na puan uah dangka-eng a zephoihnate hon koihsakpa ahi.
Kidou laitak a mihatte apuk maizen uh! Aw, Jonathan, na mun sangte ah nang ahon thatta uhi.
Ka unaupa Jonathan, na tungthu ah ka lungzing petmah hi. Ka tung ah na hoih mahmah a, N'on itna alamdang a, numei itna akhup hi.
Mihatte apuk ua, kidouna galvante leng amangthang khinta!
